scope: Stage 1A pilot; intentionally limited to calm, inviting, safe pending theory-driven nine-emotion taxonomy
notes: These are manually authored exploratory candidates, not human-validated synonyms or empirical findings.
family=core denotes prospective close paraphrases, pending semantic counterexample screening.
family=facet denotes semantically related but non-equivalent attributes; do not aggregate into paraphrase score.
opposition contains distinct control types; do not equate antonym and logical negation.
Expanded to 20 hypotheses per pilot emotion; core families are candidate near-paraphrases rather than verified equivalent expressions.
Testing is not automatic hypothesis selection; do not rank candidate hypotheses by mean confidence or coverage alone.
